title: ferulago capillaris
intro: Ferulago capillaris, commonly known as Sea Fennel, is a Mediterranean plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. This plant is valued for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its various health benefits, such as reducing oxidative stress, alleviating respiratory issues, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Ferulago capillaris include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-catarrhal agent, and bronchodilator, making it a potential treatment for conditions like bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Ferulago capillaris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
